reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing Monitor – Zero Issues
reviews.comment:
I couldn’t be happier with this monitor. The ASUS ROG Strix 26.5” 1440P QD-OLED (XG27ACDNG) has been flawless so far. The picture quality is incredible — colors are vibrant, blacks are truly deep thanks to the QD-OLED panel, and everything looks insanely sharp at 2560x1440.
The 360Hz refresh rate makes a huge difference in competitive games. Motion is buttery smooth, and input feels extremely responsive. Whether I’m gaming or just browsing, everything looks and feels premium.
Setup was easy, the build quality feels solid, and I’ve had zero issues with dead pixels, flickering, or any other problems. It just works perfectly.
If you’re looking for a high-end 1440p gaming monitor, this one is absolutely worth it. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Kirill Zakharov

reviews.title: Great OLED monitor that will serve me for many years
reviews.comment:
Things I liked
-360 Hz,  moving the mouse cursor at desktop is silky smooth.  No latency delay at all.  When playing games,  there is no ghosting or anything.
-Value,  I got this monitor on sale for $629 + tax.  Great price for an semi-glossy monitor.  I left the plastic coating sheet on the screen and it still looks great.
-Built in FPS counter.  I use this feature all the time to check what fps am i getting when playing games.  Easier than using 3rd party software.
-Able to plug in external pc speakers in the headset 3.5 jack and output sound.  Perfect if you want to play console gaming on the monitor if on a budget.
-Only took me probably 30 mins to set up and it worked fine.  I never updated the firmware either.
-Brightness is fine.  I use the HDR when applicable for games.  You have to manually turn on the HDR settings in windows before going into the games.  Then you need to turn it off when you done using HDR.  SDR colors looks better at desktop than HDR.
Things I didn't like.
-Can't raise the screen that high, but the monitor is at face level so I quickly got used to it.
-Pixel cleaning reminder pop up is a hassle.  It kills my immersion when I'm watching movie or playing game and it pops up.  You can turn it off but I just do the 5 mins pixel cleaning every 8 hours so I don't risk or delaying getting burn in. So far no burn in after 3 months.  Be sure to register your monitor to get the 3 year OLED burn in warranty.
-Some old games won't display on this monitor like Resident Evil HD remaster that I noticed.  Be sure to have an old monitor handy if you run into some problems.
reviews.author: John Cheung

reviews.title: Best 360hz oled
reviews.comment:
I've been using this monitor for a few months now; it's the fastest and most beautiful monitor I have ever owned. The colors are amazing out of the box, playing games and watching content looks stunning with 1440p, vibrant colors, and customizable settings it offers.
The 360 hz and 0.03ms response time makes fps games very smooth with no ghosting or lag. The monitor has oled care features others don't offer to keep the monitor lasting longer and an efficient custom heatsink along with the 3-year warranty.
It's also G-sync and FreeSync compatible so you don't have to worry about having the right GPU.
This monitor is worth getting if you're looking for a premium monitor around this price range.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.title: Great oled display for a great price!
reviews.comment: Amazing monitor with rich color and great pixel clarity during movement. I could never go back to any other monitor. The price is well warranted and I would even consider it a steal.
reviews.author: Mandi

reviews.title: Absolutely amazing
reviews.comment:
I recently got my hands on the XG27ACDNG, and I have to say—it’s one of the most thrilling displays I’ve ever used. Right out of the box, its ultra‑slim bezels and sturdy, fully adjustable stand give it a premium look and feel. But it’s what’s behind the glass that truly wows: a blazing‑fast 360 Hz OLED panel that delivers buttery‑smooth motion and razor‑sharp responsiveness. Whether I’m tearing through the latest fast‑paced shooter or simply scrolling through a high‑res image gallery, every frame pops with vibrant color and midnight‑deep blacks—no ghosting, no smearing, just perfectly clean transitions.
Gaming on the XG27ACDNG is like upgrading your reflexes. The input lag is negligible, so I can nail even the most split‑second flick shots without feeling held back by my display—and that 360 Hz refresh rate makes everything feel impossibly fluid. But it isn’t just a one‑trick pony for gamers: content creation and movie nights look spectacular, thanks to its wide color gamut and HDR support. After weeks of using this monitor, I’m convinced it strikes the perfect balance between professional‑grade image quality and esports‑level performance. If you’re in the market for a next‑level display that doesn’t compromise on speed or picture quality, the XG27ACDNG is an absolute champion.
